Initial release for untappd-mcp.

- Search for beers, breweries, and venues on Untappd.
- View user profiles, check-ins, wishlists, badges, distinct beers, and friends.
- Read your friend activity feed and check-in details.
- Post check-ins, toasts, and comments to your Untappd account (with confirmation).
- Requires Untappd login and app client credentials for setup.
